item-100.reason: The waiter races an earlier in-flight request and can resolve on the wrong response.

item-101.reason: A brief viewport change replaces the desktop editor, leaving the expected panel absent when the locator runs.

item-102.reason: The test goes offline before form loading finishes, allowing a later remount to reset the checked state.

item-96.reason: The locator matches both the visible shell and its hidden streamed copy.

item-97.reason: Host load changes how many frames render during the fixed measurement interval.

item-98.reason: The click can occur while the camera is still moving, before the unit is reliably reachable on the canvas.

item-99.reason: Firefox retains page zoom from one test and leaks it into the next test in the same browser.
